neighbours.label: talk of preventing or reducing a health risk ('avoid eyestrain', 'can prevent', 'try to reduce your nausea')
fire: Knowing your family history before pregnancy can prevent the heartache later.
To avoid backache, nurses should bend at the knees when lifting.
Regular testing can prevent complications in people with diabetes.
You can try to lower your blood pressure by eating less salt.
To avoid dehydration, older adults should drink water through the day.
Learning about the risks before surgery can prevent needless worry.
You can try to ease your migraine with a dark room.
Early treatment can prevent the disease from reaching the lungs.
quiet: Knowing your family budget before a holiday can prevent the arguments later.
To avoid delays, drivers should stop at the bridge when loading.
Regular cleaning can prevent rust in machines with gears.
You can try to lower your gas bill by using less heat.
To avoid crowds, older visitors should tour the castle through the week.
Learning about the fees before moving can prevent needless spending.
You can try to ease your commute with a bicycle.
Early booking can prevent the tour from reaching its limit.

notes: Low-confidence guess, and I expect it to fail. Card: ',' x4, 'M' of MCI, ' to', ' you', ' treatment', ' avoid', ' prevent'. Probe: ' prevent' after 'before having a baby' 0.754, but in other health sentences only 0.039-0.118, against 0.015-0.105 for non-health frames.
